visual.observation: A promotional one-pager labeled "Forsage BUSD 2022 | One-Pager" describes income in BUSD from a multi-level referral network and shows x3, x4, xX, and xGold programs with diagrams for direct partners and team development.
visual.context: Promotional program overview presenting the material as an income opportunity, not as a warning or report.
visual.potential_relevance: It explicitly links promised BUSD income and "fast income" or "long-term profit" wording to recruiting direct partners and developing a team through tiered programs.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish that payouts occur, that the program is deceptive, or that any viewer acted or lost money.

visual.observation: Multiple profile screenshots show visible profit or earning amounts in BUSD, personal referral links with Copy/Share controls, and partner or team counts; one overlay reads "INVITE AND EARN MONEY."
visual.context: Promotional or testimonial-style account screenshots showing claimed member results.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed earnings are presented together with personal links and partner or team counts, creating an observable reward-for-referral relationship.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish the source, authenticity, timing, or withdrawal of the displayed amounts, and do not show any required payment or data submission.

visual.observation: A "Forsage Sagar Team" network-marketing or MLM explainer displays a WhatsApp contact route while describing participation in a distribution network; associated program material presents partner- and team-based BUSD income.
visual.context: Introductory promotional explainer for a network-marketing opportunity.
visual.potential_relevance: The contact channel is presented as a route to engage with the network-marketing opportunity, while the associated material advertises income connected to partners and team development.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show what happens after contact, whether a fee or personal information is requested, or whether the branding represents a legitimate entity.

visual_context_notes.observation: The material visibly labels itself as "Network Marketing" or "MLM" and "Forsage Sagar Team," with a distribution-network illustration.
The one-page overview uses tiered referral diagrams and BUSD-related income descriptions.
Several account-style panels show personal links, profit figures, and partner or team counts.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in a Forsage BUSD network-marketing program through WhatsApp and presents tiered programs with income tied to direct partners and team development. Account screenshots reinforce the solicitation with personal referral links, partner and team counts, and BUSD earning figures; the frames do not establish whether the earnings were authentic or withdrawn, or whether viewers paid or lost money.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The one-pager links income to direct partners and team development across tiered programs. The account-style screens reinforce that presentation by displaying personal links alongside profit figures and partner and team counts; the figures are displayed claims, not verified payouts.
